zh.siteTagline: 健康数据 · 中医解读
zh.heroTitle: 智能中医健康管理，简单易用
zh.heroDesc: 🪷 小树中医将 Apple 健康数据与中医理论结合，为您提供体质分析、脉象解读、舌象自测与个性化养生建议。
zh.featuresSubtitle: 基于 TreeletTCM iOS 应用的完整功能
zh.featureHealthOverviewDesc: 📊 整合心率变异性(HRV)、体温、静息心率、睡眠质量、血氧、步数、活动能量与日照等数据，生成中医视角的「今日建议」、养生卡片、精气神分数、脏腑指数、血瘀/湿气指数，以及脏腑辨证解读。
zh.featurePulseDesc: ⌚ 与 Apple Watch 联动，采集脉象波形。基于「一息四至」「一息五至」等传统脉象标准，解读气血状态、脏腑状况与病邪性质，并给出调理建议。
zh.featureConstitutionDesc: 📋 结合体温与 HRV 等健康数据，判断体质倾向：平和质、气虚质、阳虚质、阴虚质、气郁质、血瘀质、痰湿质、湿热质、特禀质等九种体质，并提供个性化调理方案与四季养生建议。
zh.featureTongueDesc: 📸 AI 辅助舌诊：拍摄舌象后，分析舌色、舌形、苔质苔色，输出舌象报告与脏腑关联解读，支持历史记录与趋势查看。
zh.featureOrganDesc: 🔬 根据健康数据推断心、肝、脾、肺、肾、胃、胆、大肠、小肠、膀胱等脏腑状态，识别常见证型（如肾阳虚、寒湿困脾、心血瘀等），并给出定义、表现、治法与食疗建议。
zh.featureDailyDesc: ✨ 根据当日健康数据动态生成「今日宜」与「今日忌」，涵盖饮食、运动、作息与情志，助您日日顺时养生。
zh.featurePreserveDesc: ⏰ 药食同源食谱、养生运动与四季养生建议；结合十二时辰推送养生提醒，助您顺应天时调理身心。
zh.aboutDesc: 小树中医致力于让专业的中医体质与健康解读变得人人可及。我们结合 Apple 健康数据与中医理论，在尊重隐私的前提下，为您提供体质分析、脉象舌象解读与个性化养生建议，所有解读仅供参考，不能替代专业医疗诊断。
zh.disclaimerText: 本应用提供的中医解读仅供参考，不能替代专业医疗诊断。如有健康问题，请咨询专业中医师或医疗机构。

en.heroTitle: Smart TCM Health Management, Made Simple
en.heroDesc: 🪷 Treelet TCM combines Apple Health data with Traditional Chinese Medicine to offer constitution analysis, pulse interpretation, AI-assisted tongue diagnosis, and personalized wellness tips.
en.featuresSubtitle: Full feature set from the TreeletTCM iOS app
en.featureHealthOverviewDesc: 📊 Integrates HRV, temperature, resting heart rate, sleep quality, SpO₂, steps, active energy, and daylight exposure into TCM-style Daily Recommendations, health preservation cards, Essence-Qi-Spirit scores, organ indices, blood-stasis/dampness indices, and organ syndrome differentiation.
en.featurePulseDesc: ⌚ Works with Apple Watch to capture pulse waveforms. Interprets qi-blood status, organ condition, and pathogenic factors using classical criteria (e.g. four beats per breath), with conditioning advice.
en.featureConstitutionDesc: 📋 Uses temperature, HRV, and other health data to assess constitution type: Balanced, Qi Deficiency, Yang Deficiency, Yin Deficiency, Qi Stagnation, Blood Stasis, Phlegm-Dampness, Damp-Heat, and Special constitutions, with personalized conditioning and seasonal health guidance.
en.featureTongueDesc: 📸 AI-assisted tongue diagnosis: after taking a tongue photo, get analysis of tongue color, shape, and coating, with a full report and organ-related interpretation, plus history and trends.
en.featureOrganDesc: 🔬 Infers the state of Heart, Liver, Spleen, Lung, Kidney, Stomach, Gallbladder, Large/Small Intestine, and Bladder from health data, identifies common patterns (e.g. Kidney Yang Deficiency, Cold-Dampness Encumbering Spleen, Heart Blood Stasis), and provides definitions, manifestations, treatment principles, and dietary advice.
en.featureDailyDesc: ✨ Generates day-by-day “Recommended” and “Taboo” based on your health data, covering diet, exercise, routine, and emotions for timely daily wellness.
en.featurePreserveDesc: ⏰ Food-as-medicine recipes, preservation exercises, and seasonal tips; 12 two-hour periods (shichen) reminders help you align routine with natural cycles.
en.aboutDesc: Treelet TCM aims to make professional TCM constitution and health interpretation accessible. We combine Apple Health data with TCM theory to offer constitution analysis, pulse and tongue interpretation, and personalized wellness advice. All content is for reference only and does not replace professional medical care.
en.disclaimerText: TCM interpretations in this app are for reference only and cannot replace professional medical diagnosis. Please consult a qualified TCM practitioner or healthcare provider for health concerns.
en.seoKeywords: Treelet TCM,TCM app,constitution analysis,pulse diagnosis,tongue diagnosis,Chinese medicine,Apple Health
